name: Paul Mockapetris
biography: is Chairman and chief Scientist at Nominum, a company which supplies DNS and DHCP software to carriers and others. Paul is the inventor of the DNS protocol, and was the first implementer of SMTP. He believes he put the "S" in SMTP, and that complexity is the enemy. He is the veteran of several Silicon Valley successes and disasters.
